integrationEvidence: New search UI source actually read in full: DocsSearch.astro loads one current-locale metadata directory and one generated shared search engine. docs-search.ts creates a Pagefind1.5.2 instance, checks index schema/locale, initializes it, reads result.data() and uses the same engine function as acceptance. Retry clears failed resources and cache-busts failed module imports; request tokens prevent stale asynchronous results from overwriting current input or a closed dialog. Keyboard shortcut, clear, native dialog close and focus restoration have source-level paths. No browser execution is claimed.

Read final generator search-documents.mjs after scope correction: it consumes actual generated HTML for all34 published normal pages per locale, including home/examples/blog-list, verifies html lang/self canonical/custom search meta/unique h1 and description, serializes only the current locale concept map and terms, and copies exact search.mjs engine bytes. Non-docs/article pages use empty term arrays rather than fabricated aliases. Actual HTML title becomes weak pageTitle evidence while displayed result title remains actual H1. Managed inactive-language directories are cleaned without arbitrary file deletion. No cross-locale directory is loaded by the UI; Pagefind body indexing remains separate.

Read pure search.mjs completely and re-read final scope/title delta: NFKC/case/diacritic normalization; symmetric English morphology; Intl.Segmenter plus Han bigrams; snake_case splitting; numeric-only tokens excluded; concept aliases have lexical boundaries and longest matches first. requiresAny and requiresAll contextGroups both constrain query/document feature matching, and consumeContext applies to both groups. Scores combine H1(5), description(3), terms(2.5), actual Pagefind body(0.9), actual HTML pageTitle(2.5), IDF, coverage and declared task-role/SDK priors; unknown words are not AND gates. Home/examples/blog-list roles are selected by actual page type. Output is restricted to supplied real document URLs, not invented links or completion text.

Read every en/zh-CN search-concepts entry. SDK names and generic task-role synonyms are domain vocabulary rather than canned whole-query routes. fundamentals/package-structure require relevant subject context, update/review-history concepts require update context, learning words have low0.25 weight. Custom field/layout, note/card cardinality, and image-covering concepts are supported by custom-model/concepts/occlusion content. Unverified Alpine/musl/Bun/Electron and Anki re-export terms route to constraint explanations; they do not assert support. Added cardinality requires both note and card groups. Earlier transient data/engine requiresAll mismatch was corrected and actually re-read before approval.

UI output uses textContent for titles/snippets/subsection labels and only same-origin HTTP(S) links. Sub-results must belong to the parent pathname and have unique fragments. plainSearchText strips Pagefind highlight markup and decodes entities before text rendering. No dynamic AI generation, note upload, new SDK capability or query-result truth guarantee is introduced by retrieval.

Current SiteLayout/route adapter canonical/hreflang/x-default, llms describedby, Markdown alternate, RSS and JSON-LD generation remain the reviewed implementation. Search metadata is custom Pagefind input; document body and machine-export source are not rewritten by the search sorter. Official Pagefind primary API/types inspected: https://pagefind.app/docs/api/ and https://github.com/pagefind/pagefind/blob/main/pagefind_web_js/types/index.d.ts (createInstance/init/search/result.data/destroy). No frozen query text or search results were read in this source review.

resolvedIssues.explanation: During concurrent source preparation, newly authored note/card cardinality concepts required both subject groups but the earlier engine only implemented requiresAny, so their context would have been ignored.
fixEvidence: Final conceptDefinitions maps requiresAll to contextGroups.
Final hasContext requires contextGroups.every(group => group.some(matches)) together with requiresAny.
Both query features and document feature evidence call the same hasContext; consumeContext handles group aliases.

resolvedIssues.explanation: Earlier custom search directory excluded home/examples/blog-list, which meant the new sorter would discard real Pagefind hits for those normal-page URLs.
fixEvidence: Final generator uses all publishedPages,34normal pages per locale.
Non-content pages receive terms[] without invented aliases.
Actual HTML pageTitle adds weak field evidence; actual H1 remains result label.
Final documentRole handles home/examples/blog-list by page type; result URLs still originate only from the supplied same-locale directory.
